The most recent Republican elected governor of New York was **George Pataki**, who won the 1994 gubernatorial election and was re‑elected in 1998.  
When Pataki was first elected in 1994, he appeared on the ballot under **four party lines**:

1. **Republican Party of New York** (the primary party line)  
2. **Conservative Party of New York** (cross‑endorsement)  
3. **Tax Cut Now Party** (cross‑endorsement)  
4. **Liberal Party of New York** (cross‑endorsement)

These four lines are listed in the “Party” and “Alliance Parties” fields of the 1994 New York gubernatorial election entry on Wikipedia【1†L0-L4】.
